text: 外交部发言人宣布：经中加双方商定，第二次中加经济财金战略对话将于11月9日在加拿大举行。中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理、中加经济财金战略对话中方牵头人何立峰与对话加方牵头人、加财政部长商鹏飞、国际贸易部长西杜将共同主持对话。（央视）
text_en: Foreign Ministry Spokesperson announced: As agreed by China and Canada, the second China-Canada Economic and Financial Strategic Dialogue will be held in Canada on November 9. He Lifeng, Member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Vice Premier of the State Council and Chinese co-chair of the China-Canada Economic and Financial Strategic Dialogue, will co-chair the dialogue with Canadian co-chair and Finance Minister Francois-Philippe Champagne and International Trade Minister Maninder Sidhu. (CCTV)
